number_of_biological_replicates: The raw data were obtained from three biological replicates for each strain, were processed using Proteome Discoverer 2.4.0.305 software (Thermo Fisher Scientific, Inc., Waltham, MA, USA), and searched against the ToxoDB-46_TgondiiME49 database.
technology_type: Protein identification and quantitation were performed by nanoLC-MS/MS.
